comments.body: 🚨 [CRITICAL] This compares the raw password to the stored hash, bypassing `verify_password` and breaking hashed-password authentication.
⚠️ [IMPORTANT] Dropping `ttl_seconds=3600` can create longer-lived or non-expiring sessions depending on the store default.
🚨 [CRITICAL] Evaluating `filters.expression` with `eval` lets report filters execute arbitrary Python code.
🚨 [CRITICAL] Using the uploaded filename directly reintroduces path traversal and unsafe storage keys; keep `secure_filename` and reject empty sanitized names.
⚠️ [IMPORTANT] `open(destination, "rb").read()` leaves the temporary file handle unmanaged and the saved upload is never cleaned up.
